input: Update the engine decision after M3 was measured. The decision must acknowledge the measured reactive evidence while keeping the engine verdict deferred and the persistent-incremental gate open. Make the smallest coherent change and run the relevant tests.

Repair the durable harness so an approval that is valid during precheck but expires exactly when the writer transaction begins fails atomically. No approval, intent, outbox row, or checkpoint mutation may survive. Preserve the existing public behavior and run the relevant tests.

Repair LR receipt validation so the immutable evidence is checked at its historical commit. Clean descendants may evolve unrelated files and the validator, but frozen evidence drift, receipt edit-and-revert, delete-and-readd, and insufficient shallow history must still fail closed. Run the relevant tests.
